index_effect: struct S{x:i64,y:i64}var rows:S[]=[S{7,-8},S{40,50}];var calls:i64=0;recursive fn index()->i64{calls++;return 0;}recursive fn rhs()->S{assert(calls==1);rows[0].x=99;return S{3,4};}fn main(){rows[index()]+=rhs();assert(calls==1&&rows[0].x==10&&rows[0].y == -4&&rows[1].x==40&&rows[1].y==50);print("index_effect");}
receiver: struct S{x:i64,y:i64}var source=S{7,-8};var calls:i64=0;recursive fn receiver()->S&{calls++;return source;}recursive fn rhs()->S&{source.x=99;return source;}fn main(){receiver().x+=3;assert(calls==1&&source.x==10);var holder=source;recursive fn select()->S&{calls++;return holder;}select()+=rhs();assert(calls==2&&holder.x==109&&holder.y == -16&&source.x==99);print("receiver");}
rebind: var a:i64[2]=[7,-8];var b:i64[2]=[40,50];var target .= a;recursive fn rhs()->i64[2]{target .= b;return [3,4];}fn main(){target+=rhs();assert(a[0]==10&&a[1] == -4&&b[0]==40&&b[1]==50);assert(target .== &b);print("rebind");}

early_return: recursive fn choose(flag:bool)->i64{var a:i64[2]=[7,8];a*=(if flag{return 55;}else{2});assert(a[0]==14&&a[1]==16);return a[0]+a[1];}fn main(){assert(choose(true)==55&&choose(false)==30);print("early_return");}
